entries.zh: 情愿；甘愿，出于本心自愿（西语谓「随己意而愿」）
entries.en: to be willing; to consent of one's own will

entries.zh: 投充〔原稿第二字作「克」，疑当作「充」〕；自愿投身归属，投靠人家门下充作仆役
entries.en: to attach oneself to a household; to offer oneself for enrollment or service
entries.notes: 第二字原稿疑「克／充」，据闽南语对音与词义取「充」，即投靠充役之义。

entries.zh: 爱野；喜好游冶、贪恋不正当的消遣娱乐（原文注明「不正当娱乐」，多指狎邪游乐）
entries.en: to delight in illicit amusements; debauchery

entries.zh: 爱加；想要更多，愿再增添
entries.en: to want more; to wish to add or increase

entries.zh: 爱减；想要减少，愿其削减
entries.en: to want less; to wish to diminish or take away

entries.zh: 爱添；想要增添，愿再加于其上（西语谓「愿使其有所添增」）
entries.en: to wish something to be added; to want more added

entries.zh: 割舍；割爱舍弃，甘愿把财物给人而舍去
entries.en: to give up, to part with; willing to let something go (Sp. querer dar se lo, "to want to give it away")
entries.notes: 西语词尾有「de／el」之疑，然不影响汉字「割舍」之释义。

entries.zh: 青草药；新鲜的药用草药、民间生草药
entries.en: fresh herb medicine, folk herbal remedies (the Spanish headword "querer sin justicia" does not match the Chinese gloss and appears corrupt)
entries.notes: 西语词头「querer sin justicia」与汉字「青草药」义不相涉，疑有窜误；释义从汉字与闽南语对音。

entries.zh: 就爱用〔首字原稿疑「就／訧」〕；愿意凑就听用、甘受使唤，即愿充当仆役
entries.en: to be willing to serve; ready to be employed
entries.notes: 首字疑「就／訧」，据闽南语对音取「就」；「就爱用」谓愿意听人使唤、为人服务。

entries.zh: 侵地界；侵占他人地界，图谋占据别人的田产
entries.en: to encroach on another's land boundaries; to covet another's estate

entries.zh: 侵取；侵夺占据他人的财物产业
entries.en: to seize and take another's property by encroachment

entries.zh: 情愿；同心一意、两相情愿（西语谓「出于同一意愿」，较单言情愿更重两愿相合）
entries.en: of one accord, with a single will; mutually willing

entries.zh: 乳；乳汁、奶水（对音作「乳奶」）。西语词头作「queso」（奶酪）而汉字仅作「乳」，两栏不尽对应
entries.en: milk (the Chinese gloss reads 乳/乳奶 "milk"; the Spanish headword queso "cheese" does not fully match)
entries.notes: 词头「q̃／el」与对音第二字「nay／say」皆有疑；汉字与对音均指向「乳（奶）」，西语 queso 与之不尽对应，释义从汉字。

entries.zh: 乳饼；鲜奶酪压制的饼状乳制品，如市上所卖之小饼
entries.en: fresh cheese pressed into small cakes, like the little loaves sold in the market; milk cake
entries.notes: 西语 tortexos／torteros 拼写有疑，指饼状鲜奶酪；不影响汉字「乳饼」释义。

entries.zh: 牛乳菓〔第三字原稿作「巢」，疑当作「菓」，糕饼义〕；牛乳凝制之糕饼，即奶酪
entries.en: cheese (Chinese literally "cow-milk cake", a molded milk confection)
entries.notes: 第三字疑「巢／菓」，据闽南语对音与词头 queso 取「菓」（糕饼义），非「巢」。
